package player

// ddsonic contract (Slice B): go-librespot's CDN quarantine map is shared by
// concurrent stream setups on one Player. These tests drive the real
// httpChunkedReaderFromStorageResolve and its real map from two goroutines,
// with a barrier in each goroutine's own transport so that their map
// accesses come after one shared release and are ordered by nothing else.
// Under the race detector they fail against the unpatched base and pass
// against the replacement, which guards each access. This file names nothing
// the patch adds, so it compiles against both.

import (
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	librespot "github.com/devgianlu/go-librespot"
	downloadpb "github.com/devgianlu/go-librespot/proto/spotify/download"
)

type ddsonicBarrierRT struct {
	once    sync.Once
	arrive  *sync.WaitGroup
	release <-chan struct{}
	respond func(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error)
}

func (b *ddsonicBarrierRT) RoundTrip(req *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	b.once.Do(func() {
		b.arrive.Done()
		<-b.release
	})
	return b.respond(req)
}

func ddsonicCDNFail(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	return nil, errors.New("ddsonic contract: cdn host unavailable")
}

func ddsonicCDNServe(req *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	return &http.Response{
		StatusCode: http.StatusPartialContent,
		Header:     http.Header{"Content-Range": []string{"bytes 0-0/1"}},
		Body:       io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader("x")),
		Request:    req,
	}, nil
}

// ddsonicConcurrentResolves runs two resolutions of urls on p at once, each
// with its own transport, released together; it returns their results.
func ddsonicConcurrentResolves(t *testing.T, p *Player, urls []string, respond func(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error)) ([]error, []io.Closer) {
	t.Helper()
	var arrive sync.WaitGroup
	arrive.Add(2)
	release := make(chan struct{})
	errs := make([]error, 2)
	readers := make([]io.Closer, 2)
	done := make(chan struct{}, 2)
	for i := range 2 {
		client := &http.Client{Transport: &ddsonicBarrierRT{arrive: &arrive, release: release, respond: respond}}
		go func() {
			defer func() { done <- struct{}{} }()
			r, err := p.httpChunkedReaderFromStorageResolve(&librespot.NullLogger{}, client, &downloadpb.StorageResolveResponse{
				Result: downloadpb.StorageResolveResponse_CDN,
				Cdnurl: urls,
			})
			errs[i] = err
			if r != nil {
				readers[i] = r
			}
		}()
	}
	arrive.Wait()
	close(release)
	for range 2 {
		select {
		case <-done:
		case <-time.After(30 * time.Second):
			t.Fatal("a resolution did not return within 30s")
		}
	}
	return errs, readers
}

// Two setups whose CDN host fails both record the failure in the map.
func TestDDSonicContractCDNConcurrentFailures(t *testing.T) {
	p := &Player{cdnQuarantine: make(map[string]time.Time)}
	errs, _ := ddsonicConcurrentResolves(t, p, []string{"https://a.ddsonic.invalid/f"}, ddsonicCDNFail)
	for i, err := range errs {
		if err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("resolution %d succeeded against a failing host", i)
		}
	}
	if _, found := p.cdnQuarantine["a.ddsonic.invalid"]; !found || len(p.cdnQuarantine) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("the failing host is not the one quarantined host: %v", p.cdnQuarantine)
	}
}

// With one host already quarantined, two setups that succeed on another host
// both delete it from the populated map, and the quarantined one stays.
func TestDDSonicContractCDNConcurrentDeletesOnPopulatedMap(t *testing.T) {
	p := &Player{cdnQuarantine: map[string]time.Time{"a.ddsonic.invalid": time.Now()}}
	errs, readers := ddsonicConcurrentResolves(t, p, []string{"https://b.ddsonic.invalid/f"}, ddsonicCDNServe)
	for i, err := range errs {
		if err != nil || readers[i] == nil {
			t.Fatalf("resolution %d failed against a serving host: %v", i, err)
		}
		readers[i].Close()
	}
	if _, found := p.cdnQuarantine["a.ddsonic.invalid"]; !found || len(p.cdnQuarantine) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("the quarantine changed beyond the serving host: %v", p.cdnQuarantine)
	}
}
